GenAiPlugin.description: Use this topic when the user wants to prepare for an upcoming client or deal meeting, generate a “meeting prep card”, or get a pre‑read summary for a scheduled meeting. Trigger when prompts mention “meeting prep”, “prep card”, “prepare for meeting”, “tomorrow’s meetings”, or similar meeting-readiness language.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: Identify the most recent upcoming meeting based on: The current record context Contact.
Build a prep card containing: Meeting details (subject, date/time, organizer). Account and Contact background (firm, role, relationship history) & summaries the five recent interactions.

When the user is in chat: If they say “show prep here”, present the card in chat. Execute Action "" If they say “send prep by email”, format content so it can be emailed to the relevant internal users. ""
If fails to generate the Meeting Prep Card "We’re unable to generate the Meeting Prep Card at the moment. Thanks for your patience—please try again soon."
If no future events are available on the record page, display the fallback message: “No future events found for this record. Meeting Prep Card generation was skipped.”

GenAiPlugin.scope: On‑demand meeting prep from record or chat for a specific meeting.
